findings.text: _signature_counts_agree is now dead: its only caller was the cold-read guard the diff replaced with _signature_ids_agree at run_store.py:1446, yet the diff still rewrote its body to add a BEGIN/commit pair, so the change carries a function nothing calls and an untested transaction change inside it (git grep at 7fb1eba248 finds only the definition).

_signature_ids_agree reads every stored run_id and every present mirror run_id on every cold read, where the count check it replaced read two index counts; the node's own probe records the cost on projects that already agreed (probe-project-mirror.log: imas-codex 2,101,668 bytes at base against 13,824,397 at head, nova 2,052,517 against 13,365,655), which raises the monitor's per-process cold-read cost 3-6x on eleven of thirteen projects - acceptable against the 62 MB scan it removes, but a direction the done_when's 5 MB bound on a 50-row test store cannot see.

The fragment states the probe arms measured 261122dfe6 at this revision, but the log it cites records revision_head=744b9e91b4ab5fa63fc3802e894d1a8b0292fce5 (probe-project-mirror.log:2) and the head arm's module path is the worktree, not that sha; the trees are identical because 261122dfe6 is docs-only, so the conclusion holds, but the citation names a revision the receipt does not.

_signature_from_row restates the row-to-signature projection and the hardcoded positional slices (_rebuild_signatures at run_store.py:2107 builds the same LENGTH(payload), LENGTH(detail), QUERY_KEYS, ROW_REVISION, activity_seconds tuple with row[4:10]/row[10]/row[11]); a change to QUERY_KEYS must now be made in two places, and the second copy is reached only by the reconciliation path the gate exercises indirectly.
